payload.folded: sp1: the S4 poll-timeout risk is DISARMED on evidence - AbortSignal.timeout bounds a hanging read (322ms), so the E2 Transport's pollSince wraps its fetch in a timeout and the in-board poll (K1) is confirmed safe; adr-phone-poll-in-board stands unamended, no gate reopens. The at-risk S4 becomes a fixed E2 build duty with a known mechanism rather than an open unknown. Nothing upstream invalidated.
payload.promotions: The spike script stays throwaway (workspace/, deleted at ship). Its MECHANISM promotes: the AbortSignal.timeout pattern becomes the E2 NtfyTransport's pollSince/publish timeout, and the hanging-server fixture becomes the fitness F-c test (pollAnswers returns within bound against a stalled mock). No code promoted verbatim - the pattern is a one-liner.
